reviews.text: I really appreciated how honest and upfront they were about grooming my cat. I had plenty of questions and they answered them with patience. She had some matted fur on her back and I was nervous about taking her to a groomer for the first time. She’s an incredibly shy cat with dental issues so she’s been to the vet plenty of times. I was just unsure of how she would handle being groomed. I felt like they really took care of her and her fur is so much healthier now.
Thank you for taking the time to review us
I’m very pleased that this grooming place does a beautiful job on my little baby!

Great grooming, we have been coming for years with our Corgi and they do an amazing job, plus excellent professional doggy pictures. How can you go wrong?, highly recommended, excellent service and reasonably prices.
Excellent work, very kind and friendly with the dogs. They dedicate time to each dog. I loved the haircut, totally recommended.
First time here, and definitely will be going back . Service is very good 👍

I’ve been taking my shorkie here for 3 years now they do an absolutely amazing job every single time with her grooming. Customer service is amazing and they truly care about your pet. Will continue to bring my little baby here moving forward.

IN loveeeeee with their services!!! I came all the way from New Jersey and absolutely loved the services they provided. Ginger smelled and looked fabolous. I couldn’t believe how calm he was during his bath/groom. You could tell they love what they do. 10/10!

I have been taking my 2 doggies for years,  even when I moved out hour and half from Dalila's,  I still drive there to grooming my babies because this place provides the best service.  They treat my angels with love and they make them look so nice.

We travel to Queens from Westchester to use Dalila’s. The employees are wonderful with our two dogs. The Yorkie is difficult (high energy and constantly moving) and they are so good with her. I am always extremely satisfied with how beautiful my dogs look after going there. Try using them and I guarantee you will never go anywhere else!
Best groomer EVER! They always do an amazing job, our dog has senstive ears and they are always mindful! Highly recommend!
Excellent service, 100% recommend going here. Thank you so much Dalila’s pet grooming.

We've been going here for 3 years now and the services haven't changed at all! They've still committed to giving great results and amazing pet service. My dog is very picky with whoever grooms here and she's taking a liking to the groomers in this shop. If you are a new pet parent seeking someone to do your cats/Dogs hair you should definitely seek this stores services!
Excellent service, they made my dogs look divine! Highly recommended for pampering our furry friends 🥰❤️

The front desk staff were nice, but the grooming options were very limited, basically just a lion cut or a basic deshedding service. I wanted my cat to get a trim that wasn't so drastically short, just enough to keep him cooler in the summer, but because the options were so limited, and I didn't fully realize what the lion cut actually meant, I agreed to it in person after already paying my deposit (on the phone, they told me he can get a haircut and did not inform me that the only main option is a lion cut before i paid my deposit). They ended up shaving him down to the skin, and he started licking the area obsessively and developed an open wound that was bleeding. Since then I've had to buy ointments and medication to help him heal, and he's had to wear a cone for weeks, while his hair grows back. I don't understand why they don't offer more variety in haircut lengths. I've previously taken him to PetSmart, and they had no problem giving him a shorter but not shaved to the skin cut. I'd think twice before bringing your cat here for grooming.
